personalInfo.summary: Top Rated Upwork freelancer specializing in production LLM applications: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, LLM fine-tuning, AI agents with LangChain and LangGraph, and full-stack AI apps on AWS with Python, FastAPI, Rust, and React.

services.title: AI Agents & RAG Systems
services.desc: Tool-using AI agents and production RAG pipelines built with LangChain and LangGraph: hybrid search, reranking, and evaluation so your assistant answers accurately from your own documents and knowledge base.

services.title: Full-Stack AI Apps
services.desc: End-to-end product builds pairing high-performance AI backends (FastAPI, Axum, Django) with responsive React frontends: clean APIs, streaming LLM responses, and secure multi-tenant data isolation.

services.title: LLM Fine-Tuning & MLOps
services.desc: Fine-tune open-source LLMs and vision models (LLaMA 3, Hugging Face) on your data, then deploy on AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, or Hugging Face endpoints with Docker and Terraform.

projects.title: Khan Education: AI-Powered E-Learning Platform
projects.description: Open-source e-learning platform with interactive lessons, quizzes, and powerful admin tooling — delivered globally through a serverless AWS edge architecture.

details.challenge: Building a scalable, low-latency educational platform that handles dynamic content delivery and complex user administration globally.
details.solution: Implemented a serverless architecture using AWS CloudFront for edge caching and S3 for static assets, managed via Terraform for reproducible infrastructure.
details.outcome: Achieved sub-100ms load times for global users and reduced infrastructure costs by 40% compared to traditional EC2 hosting.

projects.title: Docgram: Chat-with-PDF RAG Social Platform
projects.description: AI-powered social platform where users share PDFs in an Instagram-style feed — every document becomes conversational through integrated AI chat built on Gemini and Pinecone.

details.challenge: Enabling meaningful social interaction around static PDF documents while providing instant, context-aware answers to user queries.
details.solution: Developed a RAG pipeline using Pinecone for vector storage and Gemini for generation, integrated into a familiar social feed UI.
details.outcome: Created a unique 'Chat with PDF' social experience, processing thousands of document pages with high retrieval accuracy.

projects.title: Mediscribe: AI Medical Transcription & Clinical Summaries
projects.description: Healthcare proof of concept that transcribes patient consultations and generates clinical summaries using Gemini's audio and language capabilities.

details.challenge: Accurately transcribing and summarizing complex medical terminology in real-time while ensuring data security.
details.solution: Leveraged Gemini's multimodal capabilities for high-fidelity transcription and PynamoDB for secure metadata handling on AWS.
details.outcome: Delivered a POC demonstrating 95% accuracy in medical term recognition and automated summarization for EMR entry.

projects.title: Health AI Agent System: LangGraph Multi-Agent Workflow
projects.description: Multi-agent system built on LangGraph that automates wellness checks, personalized video recommendations, and document Q&A.

details.challenge: Orchestrating multiple specialized AI agents (Wellness, Video, Classes) to provide a cohesive user experience without hallucinations.
details.solution: Built a stateful multi-agent system using LangGraph to route requests intelligently between vector DBs and external APIs.
details.outcome: Streamlined patient engagement workflows, reducing manual wellness check calls by automating initial triage.

projects.title: Passport MRZ Extraction & Face Verification
projects.description: Fast, secure identity-verification app that extracts passport data via MRZ parsing and confirms identity by face-matching against a selfie.

details.challenge: Automating identity verification with high reliability to prevent fraud in a high-stakes environment.
details.solution: Integrated MRZ parsing libraries with custom face-matching algorithms and deployed on a secure AWS environment.
details.outcome: Reduced identity verification time from minutes to seconds with a high confidence score for fraud detection.

projects.title: Retail Demand Forecasting with XGBoost on SageMaker
projects.description: Automated demand-forecasting pipeline built with XGBoost on AWS that optimizes retail inventory — cutting carrying costs while sharply improving forecast accuracy.

details.challenge: A retail chain was losing $5M annually to overstock and stockouts, with manual forecasting taking 3 days per product.
details.solution: Created a self-service XGBoost pipeline on AWS that auto-generates optimized sell-through forecasts for any product.
details.outcome: Improved forecast accuracy to 92%, reduced inventory costs by 15%, and cut forecasting time from 6 hours to under 15 minutes.

projects.title: RoBERTa Fake News Detection: SageMaker MLOps Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end AWS SageMaker pipeline for fake-news detection — automated preprocessing, RoBERTa training, evaluation, and deployment.

details.challenge: Creating a reproducible, end-to-end ML pipeline that automatically retrains and deploys models as new data arrives.
details.solution: Architected a SageMaker pipeline covering preprocessing to deployment, using RoBERTa for state-of-the-art NLP performance.
details.outcome: Established a robust MLOps workflow, ensuring the fake news detection model remains current with evolving misinformation trends.
